about: Held-out check: 20 messages written AFTER the prompt was tuned on scam-set.json, and never used for tuning. Fictional numbers (07700 900xxx, 555-01xx) and made-up addresses.

messages.text: Parcelforce: Customs charge of £2.99 required before delivery. Pay securely: parcelforce-customs-pay.com
Santander: We noticed a login from a new location. If this wasn't you, reply with your security code to stop it.
Mum it's Chloe, new phone! My banking app is locked and I need to pay my rent today, can you send £650? I'll pay you back Friday
Your number was drawn in the National Lottery Mobile Bonus! £25,000 is waiting. Pay a £20 release fee to claim.

Hi, I'm an investment adviser. Our members made 30% last month on gold. Send £250 to start, guaranteed returns, limited places.
